messages:
Alana: Quick ping — I'm about to open a PR to consolidate the v1->v2 migration snippets and remove duplicated examples across guides. Will tag @Mike for review. TL;DR: canonical snippets + deprecation note at top.
Mike: +1. Can you include the code sample that shows `client = new RedwoodClient({compat: true})`? Need exact param so examples match SDK.
Alana: I'm standardizing on `new Redwood({mode: "compat"})` per the latest SDK patch. Also adding a clear note: 'compat mode is a temporary shim and will be removed on 2026-09-01' — please check wording.
Vivian: Re: removal date — legal asked to push to 2026-09-01 to give enterprise customers more runway. Can we make the deprecation timeline configurable in the wording? @Sean thoughts?
Sean: 2026-09-01 works. Also please include explicit fallback guidance: how to migrate calls to `chat` flows (use `chat-0.3`) and text-generation (`text-0.5`) and an example `modelAlias` mapping snippet.
Mike: Also add a tiny diff snippet for streaming param rename — users keep breaking because the SDK renamed `stream: true` -> `streaming: true`. One-liner diff should help.
Alana: Good catch. I'll add a short diff block and a checklist. Plan to run a repo grep for `stream:` and `client.createCompletion` to catch stray examples and broken links.
docs-bot: Preview build available: https://deploy-preview/2198 — run `yarn docs:preview` to pull the preview and leave feedback. :robot_face:
Vivian: Can we include a 3-step migration checklist at the top? Customers want a one-liner checklist before the deep dive.
Alana: Yes — Draft checklist will be in the PR description: 1) enable `mode: "compat"`/pin alias, 2) update streaming params, 3) migrate to `models/*` variants. Also adding redirect rules from `/v1/` paths to `/v2/migrate/compat`.
Mike: Small nit: use `@modelAlias` examples rather than hardcoding model IDs in snippets — safer for future swaps.
Alana: Noted. I'll swap hardcoded ids to `@modelAlias` and push PR in ~30m, will drop the link here when it's up. Thanks all! :tada:
